title: Sega Flash Vol. 4
overview:
Volume 4 of Sega's European Sega Flash demo disc series, offering a sampler of Saturn games.

Playable demos:
- Sonic 3D: Flickies' Island
- Die Hard Arcade
- Virtual-On: Cyber Troopers

Non-playable demos:
- Manx TT Super Bike
- Fighters Megamix
- Mass Destruction
- Saturn Bomberman
- Sky Target
- Torico
- Amok
- Sega Ages Vol. 1
- Virtua Fighter 3
- Sega Touring Car Championship
- Last Bronx
